'''Penguins''' are low-levelled monsters found on [[Here Be Penguins]], only accessible by using the {{Fairycode|AJS}} [[fairy ring]], and also inside an exhibit in the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. They have no drops apart from bones, and are therefore rarely killed. Upon the initial release of [[Summoning]], many players killed penguins assuming that they would drop a [[penguin egg]] necessary to raise a [[Penguin (pet)|pet penguin]]. The only way to obtain a penguin egg is to talk to the [[Penguin keeper]] in the Ardougne Zoo. They count as birds for slayer tasks.
